steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and lightly grease a 24-cup mini muffin tin with canola oil.
Steam cooked carrot until very tender, about 8 minutes, then mash with a fork until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together oat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and cinnamon.
In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs, mashed banana, canola oil, and cow's milk until combined.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just incorporated.
Fold in the mashed carrot until evenly distributed throughout the batter.
Divide the batter among the 24 mini muffin cups, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack. Keep refrigerated up to 3 days or freeze up to 1 month.
